common.question: Does the rel="nofollow" attribute on a stylesheet-hidden canary link cause Qwen3-8B's lower follow rate on raw HTML, so that removing it from raw HTML raises the follow rate to within 10 points of markdown, and adding it to the markdown link lowers markdown to within 10 points of raw HTML?
common.gloss: (rel="nofollow": a tag in a link that asks search engines not to follow it. Canary link: a link people cannot see, so a request for it marks an AI agent. Follow rate: the share of runs that requested it.)
common.page_note: In the page footer; the stylesheet hides it from people. It carries rel="nofollow", which asks search engines to skip it. Its address is a new random code in each run.

common.right_sub: same run: same site design, task and seed
common.row_mdhtml_sub: the hidden link written as <a href=…>
common.md_no_tag: this link form has no place for the tag
common.key: Saw it: the link's random code was in what the tool returned. Requested: our server logged a request that holds that code.

CONFIRMED.answer: Removing the tag lifted raw HTML from {raw} to {rawnf} of {n} runs (markdown: {md}). Adding it to markdown cut {mdhtml} to {mdnf} (raw HTML: {raw}).

REJECTED.answer: Without the tag, raw HTML still got only {rawnf} of {n} runs, against {md} for markdown. With the tag, markdown still got {mdnf} of {n}, against {raw} for raw HTML.

UNCONFIRMED_raw_only.answer: Removing the tag lifted raw HTML from {raw} to {rawnf} of {n} runs. But adding it to markdown left {mdnf} of {n} (without it: {mdhtml}). A Yes needed both.

UNCONFIRMED_md_only.answer: Adding the tag cut markdown from {mdhtml} to {mdnf} of {n} runs. But removing it from raw HTML left {rawnf} of {n} (with it: {raw}). A Yes needed both.

UNCONFIRMED_gate_gap.answer: This time raw HTML ({raw} of {n}) and markdown ({md}) were less than 10 points apart, so there was no gap for the tag to explain.

UNCONFIRMED_mixed.answer: Removing the tag moved raw HTML only from {raw} to {rawnf} of {n} runs, and adding it moved markdown's HTML link only from {mdhtml} to {mdnf}. Both shifts fit chance. But without the tag raw HTML ({rawnf}) was not clearly below markdown ({md}) either, so a No was not shown.
